title: SEAT BACK- SPRING & FRAME ASM.
summary: Bucket seat back frame: the seat back spring & frame assembly, the seat back hinges (pivot arms at the bottom), the seat back escutcheon (the trim piece around the seat back lock release at the top of the seat back) and, on coupes, an insert at the upper frame. The escutcheon has its own studs (no separate stud part) that go through the seat back and take nuts from behind; the hinges and insert are screwed to the frame, and hog rings tie the trim cover to the frame springs. Related sheets: J2 (trim & pad), J4 (cover attachment), J5 (seat back lock).
